free_tier.stated: Free, USD 0/month: 50 monitors at a 5-minute monitoring interval, HTTP, port and ping monitors, basic status pages, only 5 integrations and no login seats; no credit card required
free_tier.notes: The unit counted is the monitor. The pricing page's feature list for Free also names keyword, API, UDP, DNS and location-specific monitoring, while its own answer on Free against Solo says Solo adds API, multi-location, slow-response, UDP and DNS monitoring; only HTTP, port and ping monitors, 5-minute intervals and basic status pages are taken as the free set. Monthly e-mail reports are sent for the first 3 months only.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a monitor checks a target; nothing is stored per object

retention.stated: 3 months of monitor logs on the free plan, against 12 months on Solo and 24 months on Team and Scale

egress.terms: not applicable: an outbound checker; monitor data is read back through the API at 10 requests per minute on the free plan

interface_detail: REST API v3 at https://api.uptimerobot.com/v3 with a main or monitor-specific API key, the legacy API still documented, and a remote streamable-HTTP MCP server at https://mcp.uptimerobot.com/mcp that takes OAuth or an API key as a Bearer token and shares the REST API's request quota, with tool calls limited to 10 per minute on the free plan. The v3 host answered 401 to /v3/monitors without a key. A separate no-registration endpoint creates one free 5-minute HTTPS monitor from an e-mail address after a proof-of-work challenge and the owner's one-click confirmation.
tooling: any HTTP client with an API key, the MCP server for agent clients, and the Zapier integration
chaining: Keeps up to 50 endpoints of free hosting under a 5-minute external check, which also keeps an idle-sleeping free web service awake.

limits.value: 10 API requests per minute on the free plan

binding_note: The 5-minute interval sets the detection delay of every monitor and the API answers 10 requests a minute; both bind before 50 monitors are used.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers Google, GitHub or an e-mail address, and the pricing page states no credit card is required for Free; the mobile-app page states that registration needs just an e-mail address. A no-registration flow creates a free monitor from an e-mail address confirmed with one click. A phone number is not asked for at registration: it is registered afterwards as an SMS and voice-call alert contact, which needs purchased credits.

reliability_note: no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read beyond the 3-month log retention
confidence_note: Every limit is quoted from a first-party page, and the API host answered 401 without a key. No account was opened; an authenticated API call from a free account would move it to measured.
